newsitem.title: USA: Genesis can't explain stock's drop.
newsitem.headline: Genesis can't explain stock's drop.

text.p: Genesis Insurance & Financial Services Inc said on Thursday it knew no reason for its stock's decline of more than 20 percent since Monday, although it believes short sellers are likely responsible.
The shares fell from about 3-1/4 a share Monday to close at 2-1/2 on Wednesday, and opened at 2 5/8 Thursday.
The company, which said it is in strong financial condition, believes "illicit, naked" short selling on the Nasdaq Bulletin Board brought down the shares.
It said it wants to move its shares to a "more credible arena," at either the American Stock Exchange or the Nasdaq Small Cap Market.
